prompt: What is the name of the steel roller coaster that most recently lost its title as the tallest operating steel roller coaster in the world?
answer: **Top Thrill 2** at Cedar Point in Sandusky, Ohio. It held the title from November 2024 until **Falcons Flight** opened at Six Flags Qiddiya City in Saudi Arabia in December 2025.
